name: Jungle Gym
summary:
Hello, and welcome to Jungle Gym!

Jungle Gym is a online multiplayer social hangout game with unique minigames and gameplay! Using the Gorilla Tag locomotion, traverse your way through our large array of maps and talk to friends and even make some new ones! 

We have social gamemodes, fun gamemodes to play with friends such as Floor is Lava, Tag, and more!
